Name: Fadester for OBS
Description: Direct OBS source browsing, show/hide, scenes, transitions, mixer fades, and optional creative layer controls. Midi Fadester integration is optional.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.ob.Name: Scene Info Bar
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.ob.Tooltip: Shows the OBS connection, the Program scene and, in Studio Mode, the Preview scene on the Stream Deck Neo Info Bar.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.la.Name: Source & Layer
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.la.Tooltip: Browse existing scene sources and show or hide the deck-selected source. Creative controls add blend modes and optional layer reordering.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Browse sources, blend modes, or explicitly enabled layer order
TriggerDescription.Push: Show/hide source, or reset blend to Normal
TriggerDescription.Touch: Show/hide source, or reset blend to Normal

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.ob.Name: Volume & T-bar
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.ob.Tooltip: Ride an audio source's volume, or fade Preview into Program with the T-bar.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Adjust audio volume, or fade Preview into Program
TriggerDescription.Push: Run the press action chosen in settings

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.sc.Name: Scene
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.sc.Tooltip: Go to the next, the previous, a numbered or a chosen scene: cut, transition, or put it in Preview.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.ob.Name: Audio Fade
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.ob.Tooltip: Fade an OBS mixer input up or down over a set time.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.pl.Name: Playlister
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.pl.Tooltip: Previous, next, play/pause, stop, restart or status of one Playlister source through OBS's media controls.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.ob.Name: Filter
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.ob.Tooltip: Turn a filter on or off, or ride one of its settings.

TriggerDescription.Push: Drop and return, or turn the filter on and off

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vi.Name: Visual Panic
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vi.Tooltip: Visual Sidechain's Panic (instant) and Restore visuals (hold 0.8 s), sent through OBS's own hotkeys. Panic keys show PANIC SENT until Restore visuals.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vi.Name: Visual Sidechain Meter
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vi.Tooltip: Shows BPM and the beat. Press to tap, lock or resync the tempo.

TriggerDescription.Push: Tap tempo, lock BPM, or resync beat 1

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.ta.Name: Tape Deck
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.ta.Tooltip: Ride a Visual Sidechain Tape Deck along its 25% to 800% (0.25x to 8x) speed ladder, or play/pause, cue to start, reset to 100% (1x), or step speed.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Ride speed along the 25% to 800% (0.25x to 8x) ladder
TriggerDescription.Push: Play/pause, cue to start, normal speed, or step speed

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.fa.Name: Midi Fadester Fader (optional)
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.fa.Tooltip: Optional enhanced control for an existing Midi Fadester slot.

TriggerDescription.Push: Run press action (hold 0.8 s for hold action)
TriggerDescription.Touch: Tap to jump or snap to side

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.au.Name: Midi Fadester Auto-fade (optional)
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.au.Tooltip: Optional enhanced fade for an existing Midi Fadester slot.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Name: VJster Speed
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Tooltip: Turn for speed, hold and turn for fine steps, press for 1x, tap the strip to play or pause.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Name: VJster Quality
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Tooltip: Turn to step through the video's quality levels, press or tap for Auto. YouTube only.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Name: VJster Speed Preset
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Tooltip: One fixed speed. Lights up while it is the speed playing.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Name: VJster Speed Step
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Tooltip: Faster or slower by one step.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Name: VJster Quality Preset
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Tooltip: One fixed quality level, or Auto. Dimmed when the video does not offer it.

io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Name: VJster Pin Tab
io.github.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.vj.Tooltip: Keep controlling the current Chrome tab, whatever else plays. Press again to let go.

pi.label: Label
pi.languageNote: For every Fadester for OBS key and dial. Stream Deck's own menus stay in Stream Deck's language.
pi.connAppliesAll: With OBS on this computer there is nothing to fill in: the port and the password are read from OBS. Fill this in for OBS on another computer, or when signing in fails.
pi.connOtherComputer: OBS on another computer, or another port
pi.connPortFromObs: Connected on port {port}, the one OBS itself uses on this computer.
pi.passwordFromObs: Signed in with the password OBS saved on this computer. Type one only if you use another OBS.
pi.connHintRejected: OBS rejected the saved shared password. Replace it once here for all Fadester for OBS controls.
pi.connHintSaved: Password saved for all Fadester for OBS keys and dials. You do not need to enter it again.
pi.connHintShared: One OBS connection is shared by all Fadester for OBS keys and dials.
pi.studioSetupNote: This control uses Studio Mode. Prepare Preview from your existing scenes to start mixing.
pi.studioPrepared: Studio Mode is on. Preview is ready.
pi.layoutsIntro: Fills this deck with keys that already follow your scenes and audio. You can change every key.
pi.layoutsNone: No ready-made layout for this deck yet. Drag Scene onto a key to begin.
pi.layoutTopHint: New deck? Fill it with a ready-made layout
pi.layoutsInstallNote: The layout installs once as a profile you can edit. Layouts you changed earlier stay.
pi.openDeckPickStarter: Choose “{name}” from the profile list in OpenDeck. If it is missing, restart OpenDeck and check the list again.
pi.openDeckManualStarter: Drag Scene onto an OpenDeck key to try Next scene.
pi.layoutOpenEnable: Turn on Studio Mode and open
pi.layoutNeedsObs: Connect to OBS first. Then open this layout.
pi.setupDone: Layout opened. If Stream Deck asks to import a profile, accept it.
pi.setupNoAnswer: No answer from the plugin. Try again.
pi.infobarNote: Shows the Program scene and, in Studio Mode, the Preview scene. The Info Bar is display-only.
pi.mixDisabled: Turn on All OBS mixer inputs in Fadester Companion.
pi.mixOffline: Start Fadester Companion and connect it to the same OBS.
pi.mixConflict: Two mix providers are answering. Stop the extra Fadester Companion.
pi.mixHint: Fadester Companion sets the fade time and the dial step. Restore mix returns each input to its own level.
pi.fadeIntro: Starts with Main audio from your current OBS mixer. Choose a fixed input to keep this key assigned to it.
pi.fadeInstantNote: 0 ms is instant. Any new volume move cancels a running fade for that input.
pi.fadeInputUnavailable: This audio input is unavailable in OBS. Choose another mixer input above.
pi.fadeChooseToFade: Choose an OBS mixer input to fade.
pi.sceneIntro: Scene 1, 2, 3 follow the order of your scene list in OBS. Previous, Next and Random use every scene.
pi.sceneBannerChoose: Choose Next, Previous, Random, an automatic numbered scene, or a fixed scene.
pi.sceneBannerStudio: Enable Studio Mode below to prepare this control and Preview.
pi.sceneBannerIndexOne: Scene {n} is not available. Your current OBS collection has {count} scene. Next, Previous, and Random use the whole available list.
pi.sceneBannerIndexMany: Scene {n} is not available. Your current OBS collection has {count} scenes. Next, Previous, and Random use the whole available list.
pi.faderIntro: Starts with Main audio from your current OBS mixer. Choose an automatic target or a fixed input to customize this dial.
pi.tbarHintPress: Turn to fade Preview into Program. {press} Needs Studio Mode.
pi.sceneLoopHint: Queue the next scene after each transition
pi.sceneLoopNote: After your fade finishes, the following scene in the OBS scene list becomes Preview. Wraps to the first scene at the end. You still control every fade with the dial.
pi.pressNextBlend: Next blend mode on selected source
pi.pressPreviousBlend: Previous blend mode on selected source
pi.pressNormalBlend: Reset selected source to Normal blend
pi.pressCombined: Next blend mode, then Preview to Program
pi.instrNextBlend: Press for the selected source’s next blend mode.
pi.instrPreviousBlend: Press for the selected source’s previous blend mode.
pi.instrNormalBlend: Press to reset the selected source to Normal blend.
pi.instrToggle: Press to show or hide the selected source.
pi.instrCombined: Press: the selected source’s next blend mode, then Preview to Program.
pi.pressSceneHintPreview: Preview scene: {scene}. Source selection is shared across the deck until the plugin restarts or the scene collection changes. A separate Source & Layer action can be saved with a fixed source.
pi.pressSceneHintLive: Program scene: {scene}. Source selection is shared across the deck until the plugin restarts or the scene collection changes. A separate Source & Layer action can be saved with a fixed source.
pi.pressSceneHintCombined: This press changes the source's blend mode first, then puts Preview on Program.
pi.faderBannerStudio: Turn on OBS Studio Mode to fade Preview into Program. For a single-scene setup, use Source & Layer.
pi.faderBannerSame: Program and Preview are the same scene. Choose a different scene in OBS Preview to fade between them.
pi.sliderFollowing: OBS's on-screen T-bar moves with this dial.
pi.sliderUnsupportedOs: OBS's on-screen T-bar moves with this dial only on Windows and macOS. Fading still works.
pi.sliderRemote: OBS's on-screen T-bar moves with this dial only when OBS runs on this computer. Fading still works.
pi.sliderVersion: OBS's on-screen T-bar moves with this dial only in OBS 33. Fading still works.
pi.sliderTransition: Choose the Fade transition in OBS to see its on-screen T-bar move. Fading still works.
pi.sliderPermission: To see OBS's on-screen T-bar move, allow Stream Deck (or OpenDeck) in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility. Fading still works.
pi.sliderUnreachable: To see OBS's on-screen T-bar move, keep the main OBS window open and not minimised (on Windows, run OBS normally, not as administrator). Fading still works.
pi.sliderUnavailable: Fadester for OBS's T-bar helper could not start, so OBS's on-screen T-bar stays still. Reinstalling Fadester for OBS may help. Fading still works.
pi.faderBannerChoose: Choose what this dial should control.
pi.layerIntro: Browse the sources already in your scene. The deck shares one selected source per scene until the plugin restarts or the scene collection changes. Browsing keeps your layer order unchanged.
pi.scopeAuto: Follow Preview in Studio Mode, Program otherwise
pi.dialBrowse: Browse sources · press to show / hide
pi.dialBlend: Cycle blend modes · press for Normal
pi.dialOrder: Reorder layers · press to show / hide
pi.actSelected: The source selected on the deck
pi.fixedNote: To save a source on a control across restarts, choose a non-browsing action and select A fixed source above.
pi.reorderHint: Allow this control to change layer order
pi.liveNote: This changes the picture on Program at once.
pi.groupsNote: Lists show top-level sources and groups; a group is controlled as one layer.
pi.layerStatusSavedMissing: Saved source unavailable. Choose a fixed source above to change this binding.
pi.layerStatusChooseDeck: Choose a source with the deck’s source browsing controls.
pi.layerStatusNoSources: No sources in {scene}. Add a source in OBS.
pi.mfFaderIntro: This is the advanced shared-slot integration. For normal OBS mixer and Scene T-bar control, choose {action} instead.
pi.mfAutoIntro: This is the advanced shared-slot integration. For a normal OBS mixer-input fade, choose {action} instead.
pi.cleanAllFxNeeds: Clean / All FX Off — needs Midi Fadester 0.4.0+
pi.thumbnailsHint: 96×54 in Mix two layers cells (1–2 FPS)
pi.durationHint: 0 ms = instant. A T-bar return to 0 % cancels the throw. 50–20000 ms = timed fade following the slot's curve.
pi.durationHintAllFx: Clean / All FX Off: resets enabled filter bindings in either bank to 0 %. Audio and layer controls stay unchanged. 0 ms = instant; 50–20000 ms = timed ramp.
pi.noReply: No reply from the plugin after 6 s.
pi.assignDraft: Unsaved changes. Apply in OBS when ready.
pi.assignIntro: Changes apply in Midi Fadester for the APC40, Stream Deck and every other surface. Pickers list only what the live OBS catalog offers.
pi.downloadMf: Download Midi Fadester for OBS Studio 33
pi.connIntroMf: Connect once for every Fadester for OBS key and dial, including the direct OBS actions.
pi.passwordPlaceholderSavedAll: Saved for all Fadester for OBS controls (leave blank to keep)
pi.groupOffline: {group} (offline: contract defaults, connect OBS for live names)
pi.allFxNeeds: Clean / All FX Off — needs Midi Fadester 0.4.0+
pi.ctrlOffline: Controller state is reported by Midi Fadester once OBS is connected.
pi.midiNotFound: MIDI: {device} not found. Plug it in, then reconnect in OBS.
pi.midiNone: MIDI: no device configured in Midi Fadester
pi.passwordSavedAll: Password saved for all Fadester for OBS keys and dials.
pi.allFxSentence: Clean / All FX Off: cleans enabled filter bindings in either bank. Audio and layer controls stay unchanged.
pi.assignConnect: Connect OBS to see and change what this slot does.
pi.slotNotReported: Slot '{slot}' is not reported by Midi Fadester.
pi.enabledHint: keeps this slot's assignment when turned off
pi.catalogLoading: Loading the OBS catalog… (press Refresh lists if this stays)
pi.catalogNeedsMf: Midi Fadester 0.4.0+ lists scenes, layers and sources here. Until then, type exact OBS names.
pi.unassignedNote: The slot will do nothing until it is set up again.
pi.tbarOn: Fades Program to Preview like OBS’s T-bar. Nothing to pick.
pi.tbarOff: Studio Mode is off. Turn it on in OBS (View > Studio Mode) for this to work.
pi.bypassHint: disables the filter when the fader is fully down
pi.rangeHint: {label}: {min} to {max}. Blank bounds keep the existing range, or use defaults for a new binding.
pi.rangeHintSuffix: {label}: {min} to {max} {suffix}. Blank bounds keep the existing range, or use defaults for a new binding.
pi.noFilterList: OBS did not return a filter list.
pi.noChanges: There are no changes to apply.
pi.finiteNumber: Enter a finite number for every range or calibration bound.
pi.calibrationWhole: Calibration bounds must be nonnegative whole numbers.
pi.calibrationOrder: Calibration maximum must be greater than minimum.
pi.validLayersDiffer: Layer 1 and Layer 2 must be different layers.
pi.assignConflict: This slot's assignment changed on another surface. Discard edits to load the current assignment before applying.
pi.connChanged: The OBS connection changed. Your edits are kept; review the refreshed source lists before applying.
pi.plIntro: Drives one Playlister source through OBS’s own media controls. Choose it by name; the key follows it through renames.
pi.plBannerChoose: Choose a Playlister source to control.
pi.plBannerNone: No Playlister source in OBS. Add one to a scene first.
pi.plBannerMissing: The chosen Playlister is not in OBS now: it was removed, or it is in another scene collection. Choose a Playlister.
pi.plBannerWrongKind: The chosen source is not a Playlister. Choose a Playlister source.
pi.plBannerUnsupported: This OBS WebSocket does not offer the media requests (GetMediaInputStatus, TriggerMediaInputAction). Update OBS.
pi.plNote: Status only shows the state. Play / pause toggles from the observed state. Stop first drops the Playlister’s unsent presses. Nothing is sent while the Playlister is unavailable.
pi.fxIntro: Rides one filter setting on a dial, or turns a filter on and off, sets or steps a value from a key. Choose the source and its filter by name; the control follows the source through renames.
pi.fxOpToggle: Turn the filter on or off
pi.fxOpSet: Set a value over a time
pi.fxPressToggle: Turn the filter on or off
pi.fxNote: Changes are smoothed. A setting that a fader or an Audio Modulator drives is left alone.
pi.fxBannerChooseSource: Choose the source that holds the filter.
pi.fxBannerSourceMissing: The chosen source is not in OBS now.
pi.fxBannerChooseFilter: Choose one of the source's filters.
pi.fxBannerFilterMissing: No filter of that name on the source now. A renamed filter must be chosen again.
pi.fxBannerKind: This filter is now of another kind. Choose it again to control it.
pi.fxBannerDriven: {filter} drives this setting, so the deck never writes it. Unbind it there first.
pi.fxBannerRange: This setting is not in the deck's range table: type the range it may move in.
pi.vpIntro: Sends Visual Sidechain's own Panic or Restore visuals through OBS's hotkeys; OBS does not need to be in front.
pi.vpNote: Every Panic press is sent. Panic keys show PANIC SENT until Restore visuals is accepted or OBS reconnects; meanwhile no Visual Sidechain filter is written from the deck. Restore visuals with no Panic before it changes nothing.
pi.vpCheckNote: This key needs Visual Sidechain, which comes with Midi Fadester 0.9.0 or newer in OBS. Try it once before the show: hold Restore visuals. If the key then says Needs Midi Fadester, OBS has no Visual Sidechain.
pi.fxBannerRangeChoose: Choose the range this amount may move in.
pi.fxBannerOutOfRange: OBS holds {value}, outside this range: the control does not move it until the value or the range changes.
pi.fxNoteOffTable: For this setting, type the lowest and the highest value it may have.
pi.vmIntro: Shows Visual Sidechain's live BPM, beat counter, smoothed band envelopes, and NO AUDIO, PANIC, or NOT LOADED states.
pi.vmNote: Draws smoothed envelopes and a locally stepped beat counter inside the 10 Hz per-cell limit; raw kick transients are never drawn.
pi.infobarShowVs: Show Visual Sidechain tempo in status line
pi.quantizeHint: With no tempo, it starts at once and the key shows NO TEMPO. Press again to start now; hold to cancel.
pi.tdIntro: Drives a Visual Sidechain Tape Deck filter on an OBS Browser Source (25% to 800% / 0.25x to 8x live speed).
pi.tdNote: On a dial, turning steps along the 25% to 800% (0.25x to 8x) speed ladder. Tape Decks stay outside Visual Sidechain Panic and Restore visuals.
pi.tdBannerNotLoaded: Visual Sidechain is not running in OBS. It comes with Midi Fadester 0.9.0 or newer.
pi.tdBannerNeedsUpdate: Update Midi Fadester in OBS to control Tape Decks from Fadester for OBS.
pi.tdBannerNone: No Tape Deck filter found in OBS yet. Add Visual Sidechain: Tape Deck to a Browser Source.
pi.tdBannerMissing: The chosen Tape Deck source is not in OBS now.
pi.tdBannerSpeedFader: A Midi Fadester Speed Fader currently drives this deck's speed.
pi.vsBannerTempoNeedsUpdate: Update Midi Fadester in OBS for tempo lock, bar sync, and live BPM editing.
pi.plBannerPluginMissing: Playlister is not installed in OBS (version unknown). Install Playlister in OBS to add Playlister sources.
pi.chkIntro: Red is what must be fixed. Everything else is a note.
pi.chkFixReachable: Start OBS, then tick Tools > WebSocket Server Settings > Enable WebSocket server.
pi.chkFixPassword: Type OBS's WebSocket password under OBS connection, or press Use OBS's own password there.
pi.chkFixObsVersion: Tested with OBS 33. Other versions usually work; the T-bar dial moves OBS's own slider only on OBS 33.
pi.chkFixStudioMode: Only for the T-bar dial and Preview keys: turn on Studio Mode in OBS (View > Studio Mode).
pi.chkFixFade: Only for the T-bar dial: select the Fade transition in OBS's Scene Transitions dock.
pi.chkFixElevated: Close OBS and start it normally without Run as administrator.
pi.chkFixMinimised: Restore OBS's main window from the taskbar so the native T-bar can reach it.
pi.chkFixMacAx: Allow Stream Deck (or OpenDeck) in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility.
pi.chkFixMfMissing: Optional: install Midi Fadester in OBS if you use a MIDI controller or shared slots.
pi.chkFixMfOld: Update Midi Fadester in OBS for Clean FX, slot configuration, and single-owner layer opacity.
pi.chkFixVsMissing: Optional: install Midi Fadester 0.9.0 or newer in OBS (it includes Visual Sidechain) if you use audio-reactive shaders, Visual Panic, or Tape Deck.
pi.chkFixVsOld: Install Midi Fadester 0.9.0 or newer in OBS: it includes Visual Sidechain, with live safety state, tempo lock, and Tape Deck controls.
pi.chkFixVsConflict: Remove the old Visual Sidechain plugin and restart OBS: Visual Sidechain is part of Midi Fadester now. Midi Fadester's Fadester Desk dock names the file.
pi.chkFixVsOff: Visual Sidechain in Midi Fadester did not start. Look at Midi Fadester's Fadester Desk dock or OBS's log, then restart OBS.
pi.chkFixPlMissing: Optional: install Playlister in OBS if you use Playlister Transport keys.
pi.chkFixPortOther: VJster link is held by {holder}. Close it or turn off VJster there if you use VJster on this deck.
pi.chkFixPortUnknown: Port {port} is in use by another program. Close it or choose another VJster port.
